question: Run K-means (k=3) 50 times using random_state=42 as the master seed. Build a consensus matrix where entry [i,j] is the fraction of runs in which samples i and j were co-clustered. Visualize it as a heatmap.

expected_output.guidelines: Symmetric sample-by-sample matrix with values in [0,1]; each cell must match the reference within +/-0.1; row/column order and header labels may differ.
Plot must show a symmetric sample-by-sample co-assignment matrix as a heatmap with a 0-1 color scale; color scheme, fonts, and styling may differ.
